title: ILO Report: India's Social Security Coverage Expands to 64% (Encompassing 94 Crore People)
summary: Expands social protection coverage from 19% in 2014 to 64% in 2026.

blocks.content: Expands social protection coverage from 19% in 2014 to 64% in 2026.

items: Coverage Milestone: 94 crore citizens covered under formal social security schemes.
Labor Reform Context: 4 Labour Codes consolidated and replaced 29 central labor laws.
